L9·N5363unmasked layer
Fires on digits and separator characters ("." , "/") embedded in the middle of long numeric identifier strings — phone numbers, train numbers, patent serial numbers, ABNs, software version numbers — i.e. it tracks position inside an extended run of numerals rather than any semantic content.
